sections.heading: General Terms (All Users)
content: You are 18+ and legally able to enter contracts
You are accessing Ally through a partner organization formally engaged with Ally or through direct invitation by Ally for demonstration, testing or research purposes.
You are using Ally’s platform in accordance with your affiliated organization’s rules, ethics and requirements.
You understand that Ally is NOT for real emergencies. Contact crisis services, if needed. More information: https://findahelpline.com/

sections.heading: For Ally Skills Lab (Training Simulations)
content: You understand that all the scenarios are fictional, and for training purposes only.
You understand that this doesn't replace human-supervised training, provide certification, or qualify you for independent practice.
You consent to audio and transcripts of role-play sessions being stored for quality improvement and being shared with your training organization/supervisor.

sections.heading: For Ally Assist (Session Notes)
content: You will use this only for authorized sessions per your organization's rules
For this product, audio recordings are NOT stored by Ally. Transcripts of sessions are stored and deleted based on the user organization’s decision

controlsByGame.TREX_RUNNER: Press space or tap to jump. Nothing here is scored.
controlsByGame.TIC_TAC_TOE: Click or tap a square to play. Nothing here is scored.
controlsByGame.MEMORY_MATCH: Flip two cards to find a pair. The fewer moves it takes, the closer you get to a perfect eight-move round — which is all the score is, and it counts towards nothing.
controlsByGame.CUB_N_PUP: Drag the cub along the links to the star. Drag anywhere else to turn the whole grid. Boards you solve are counted, and the count goes nowhere.
controlsByGame.SNAKE: Swipe or use arrow keys to steer. Nothing here is scored.
controlsByGame.SPROUT: Press and drag the can over the soil, or use the arrow keys and hold space. Keep the level inside the green band — too much water is as bad as too little. Nothing here is scored towards the course.

lastScoreByGame.MEMORY_MATCH: This round: {{score}}% of a perfect round

game.optional: Play as long as you like, or skip straight on — either way you're good to continue.

CUB_N_PUP.hintDragToStar: Drag the cub to the star.
CUB_N_PUP.hintRotate: Drag anywhere else to turn the grid. The cub and the star turn with it — grey links stay put.
CUB_N_PUP.hintFree: Blue links turn with the grid. Turn it to join blue and grey links up in different ways.
CUB_N_PUP.hintPivot: Green links swing round with the grid but keep pointing the same way.
CUB_N_PUP.hintRotateLink: Red links stay where they are but spin with the grid.

SPROUT.hintStart: Hold the can over the soil. Keep the water level inside the green band — too much is as bad as too little.
SPROUT.aimLeaves: Aiming at the leaves. Water on the leaves does not reach the roots.
SPROUT.stateDry: Thirsty. The soil has dried out and growing has stopped.
SPROUT.stateWet: Too wet. The saucer is flooding — ease off and let it drink.
SPROUT.leafDropped: A leaf yellowed and dropped from the wet soil.
SPROUT.leafScorched: Water sat on a leaf in full sun and scorched it.
SPROUT.bloomed: It bloomed. {{blooms}} so far this sitting.
